removed text: Gloss mine and tentative: the two bay horses are Indra's; the red one is Agni's; the green ones are the Sun's; the two asses belong to the Aśvins; the goats to Pūṣan; the spotted ones to the Maruts; the ruddy cows to Uṣas; the dark ones to Savitṛ; the many-formed ones to Bṛhaspati; the नियुत् (*niyut*) team to Vāyu.

a gloss would be mine and tentative: "as one purifies barley-meal with a sieve, where the wise fashioned speech with the mind; there friends know the marks of friendship; their auspicious mark is placed in speech"
*[Gloss, mine and tentative: the gods generated the divine Speech; beings of every form speak it; may she, the cow of speech yielding food and strength for us, come to us well praised.]*

*(Translator's gloss, the print gives none: these shining dawns have been seen in the east, bringing light; they have set the sun, the sacrifice and Agni in motion; the unwelcome darkness has gone backward.)*
(my gloss, mine and tentative: "O vanaspati, bound with the girdle, knowing the rites, carry the oblations to the gods, and speak of the giver among the immortals")
(gloss mine and tentative: "by a prefix the meaning of the root is forcibly led elsewhere, as in prahāra, āhāra, saṃhāra, vihāra, parihāra")
(my gloss, mine and tentative: "In the lap of the waters the great ones seized him; the clans stood by the king ...; the messenger of Vivasvat brought Vaiśvānara Agni from afar, Mātariśvan")

(my gloss, mine and tentative: "Which of the two is earlier, which later? How were they born, O sages? Who knows? Of their own accord they bear every name, and the two days [day and night] turn like wheels")
(my gloss, mine and tentative: "This cart of hers lies well crushed in the Vipāś; she fled far away")
